meta.description: Registry for bounded residue-update legality conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

residue_update_legality_entries.name: Residue Update Legality
residue_update_legality_entries.purpose: Represent bounded legality propagation behavior under recursive residue-update continuation systems.

residue_update_conditions.name: residue_update_legality_remains_defined
residue_update_conditions.description: Formal metrics must exist to evaluate the legality of state transitions under residue modification.

residue_update_conditions.name: recursive_legality_propagation_remains_bounded
residue_update_conditions.description: Cumulative legality constraints over recursive steps must not result in unconstrained state divergence.

residue_update_conditions.name: continuation_updates_under_residue_remain_admissible
residue_update_conditions.description: Every actualized continuation following a residue update must satisfy the new admissibility window.

residue_update_conditions.name: residue_saturation_does_not_force_global_breakdown
residue_update_conditions.description: Local saturation of residue traces does not imply the failure of the entire process structure.

residue_update_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_residue_updates_remain_detectable
residue_update_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on residue-update legality must be formally trackable.

residue_update_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_legality_witness
residue_update_conditions.description: Pruning of illegal residue states must not eliminate all possible valid continuation branches.

residue_update_conditions.name: transition_flux_under_residue_update_remains_finite
residue_update_conditions.description: The measure of events realized during residue-coupled updates must not exhibit infinite growth.

residue_update_conditions.name: legality_instability_under_recursive_update_detectable
residue_update_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register breakdown in legality propagation or residue closure.
